messages:
sophie: Quick design sync for the Private setup wizard's network step. Focus areas: compact status, screen reader narration, and wording for the CIDR helper. Prototype: https://figma.com/file/ghi789 (frame 'Network-step-compact').

lee: Quick wins: change 'allowlist' -> 'Allowed IPs'. Ensure status chips have icon+text not color-only.

anya: Microcopy: 'Local diagnostics (no config saved)' reads clearer than 'scan-only'. Also CTA verbs: use 'Start scan' not 'Run'.

ux-research: In tests, users wanted a short inline example for CIDR vs single IP. Suggest: 'Enter a single IP or CIDR range (e.g., 203.0.113.7 or 203.0.113.0/24)'. Add a collapsible 'Why we ask' link.

sophie: For a11y, after Start scan we should move focus to the compact status heading and set aria-live=polite so SRs announce progress.

lee: Failure copy should be actionable: 'TCP 443 blocked  Check outbound rules or try alternative port 8443. See full diagnostic.'

design-bot: Exported frames: Network-step-aria + Network-step-collapsed. Notes: '#status role=status; aria-live=polite; focus target after start -> #status-heading'. Link: https://figma.com/file/ghi789?node-id=12.

infra-bot: Probe endpoints: https://probe-us.redwood.ai/ping (prod), https://probe-eu.staging.redwood.ai/ping (staging). For offline diagnostics request ticket INF-920.

anya: Small UI ask: show a subtle 'Last successful scan: 8m ago' pill that is keyboard focusable and has aria-label 'Last successful scan timestamp'.

ux-research: Keep 'Advanced checks' collapsed by default. When collapsed show one-line summary like 'Advanced checks: last run 5m ago, 1 issue'.

sophie: I'll update the prototype with these notes and do a short A/B on header copy: 'Connectivity snapshot' vs 'Network quick check'. I'll share results tomorrow.

lee: Also debounce Start scan to prevent double clicks. Disable button while running and set aria-busy=true.

anya: I'll run a quick contrast + screen reader pass once updated. Thanks all :thumbsup:
